# pbs_gc_status (Data Source)

Reads the garbage collection status of a Proxmox Backup Server datastore: its schedule, when it runs next, how its last run ended, and that run's figures, as the web interface shows them under Datastore → Prune & GC. Garbage collection frees the chunks no backup uses any more; `gc_schedule` of `pbs_datastore` sets when it runs.

Needs `Datastore.Audit` or `Datastore.Backup` on the datastore. PBS reads the status from the datastore itself, so a removable datastore must be mounted and one in maintenance mode `offline` cannot be read: that is an error, which a `check` block turns into a warning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A warning in every plan when the last garbage collection of store1 failed.
# Read inside the check block, a datastore PBS cannot read — a removable one
# that is not mounted, say — is a warning too, rather than an error.
check "store1_gc" {
  data "pbs_gc_status" "store1" {
    store = "store1"
  }

  assert {
    condition     = coalesce(data.pbs_gc_status.store1.last_run_state, "OK") == "OK"
    error_message = "The last garbage collection of store1 ended with: ${coalesce(data.pbs_gc_status.store1.last_run_state, "-")}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `store` (String) Name of the datastore, such as `store1`.

### Read-Only

- `cache_stats` (Attributes) How the last run's cache of chunk digests did, which `tuning.gc_cache_capacity` of `pbs_datastore` sizes; null when PBS does not say. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cache_stats))
- `disk_bytes` (Number) Bytes of the chunks on disk after the last run. `0` before the first run.
- `disk_chunks` (Number) Chunks on disk after the last run. `0` before the first run.
- `duration` (Number) How long the last run took, in seconds; null before the first run.
- `index_data_bytes` (Number) Bytes those index files refer to: the size of all backups before deduplication. `0` before the first run.
- `index_file_count` (Number) Index files — one per backed-up archive — the last run went through. `0` before the first run.
- `last_run_endtime` (Number) When the last run ended, in seconds since the Unix epoch; null before the first run.
- `last_run_state` (String) How the last run ended: `OK`, `WARNINGS: <count>`, or the error; null before the first run.
- `next_run` (Number) When it runs next, in seconds since the Unix epoch; null without a schedule.
- `pending_bytes` (Number) Bytes of unused chunks the last run kept, because they are too recent to remove safely. `0` before the first run.
- `pending_chunks` (Number) Unused chunks the last run kept, because they are too recent to remove safely. `0` before the first run.
- `removed_bad` (Number) Chunks that verification marked as bad and the last run removed. `0` before the first run.
- `removed_bytes` (Number) Bytes of the chunks the last run removed. `0` before the first run.
- `removed_chunks` (Number) Chunks the last run removed. `0` before the first run.
- `schedule` (String) When garbage collection runs, as a calendar event; null when it runs only when started.
- `still_bad` (Number) Chunks still marked as bad after the last run. `0` before the first run.
- `upid` (String) Task ID of the last run, whose log PBS keeps; null before the first run.

<a id="nestedatt--cache_stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cache_stats`

Read-Only:

- `hits` (Number) Chunks found in the cache.
- `misses` (Number) Chunks not found in the cache.
